blocks.text: Madrid, Spain—At least 69 people have been killed and more than 100 injured after two high-speed trains collided south of Madrid on Wednesday, in Spain’s deadliest rail disaster since 2013. Here is what we know about the crash, the second serious rail accident to strike the country this year.
